messages:
Sam: quick q — i'm sketching a proposal for config overrides: add an explicit 'ownership' field + TTL for temporary overrides so we can track who borrowed a flag and auto-expire it. thinking this helps audit and reduces stale overrides. thoughts?
Maria: +1 on TTL, but how do you see ownership interacting with console approvals? do we require approver if TTL > 24h?
Sam: good Q. my draft: overrides < 1h = self-service, 1h-24h = team lead approval, >24h = product owner + oncall signoff. store owner id and a reason field.
Dalia: oncall here — we need an emergency bypass. sometimes we need instant override during incidents without approvals. can we have a one-time emergency token that logs an automated escalation and forces a shorter TTL (like 15m)?
Jordan: we should also push telemetry gating. if an override changes a routing/quota config we should auto-sample metrics for 5m after change and flag regressions. tie to rollout dashboard.
Keon: concerned about complexity in console UX. owners + TTL + approvals + emergency tokens = a lot of states. maybe surface only owner + TTL and put approvals behind the API (hidden) so the console stays simple.
Maria: agree with Keon. also need a clear rollback path: action in UI -> preview -> apply -> quick rollback button for N minutes. ops-bot: Deploy-bot: Config override created by Sam for key=route_priority; env=prod; ttl=3600s; id=cfg-20260304-87.
Sam: example payload i'm imagining:
```
{
  "key": "route_priority",
  "value": "prefer-low-cost",
  "owner": "sam",
  "reason": "runway cost spike mitigation",
  "ttl_seconds": 3600,
  "approval": "pending"
}
```
Jordan: that looks good. for telemetry gating we can attach a small evaluation job: post-change we run a background probe that compares p95 latency and error-rate to a rolling baseline. if > X% regression then auto-signal rollback.
Dalia: what about fallback routing? if an override fails to apply (eg config service timeout) we should have a deterministic fallback — current behavior is undefined. prefer explicit: if override apply fails, fallback to last known stable config and alert owner + oncall.
Keon: also add an idempotency key on override API so retries don't create duplicate overrides.
Maria: obligations: - UX: Keon + Maria will sketch console minimal flow - API: Sam + Jordan will spec JSON + approval rules - Oncall/ops: Dalia to draft emergency token + apply/rollback playbook
Sam: timeline: aim for 2-week spike: wireframes + API proto. hub for designs: https://internal.redwood/designs/config-override-proto (placeholder)
Dalia: noted. also add audit log retention requirement (90 days min) and KMS note for sensitive reason text.
Jordan: i'll prototype the telemetry probe and add a small chart to the rollout dashboard for fast eyeballing.
Keon: UX question — show owner as 'team' or individual? prefer team-level ownership (easier handoffs). we should accept both fields (owner/team) and show whichever is present.
Sam: agreed. will update spec. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
